item.text: The bug is in grant resolution: it reads only directly assigned grants, while report downloads also had a hard-coded analyst bypass. I’ve changed grant lookup to walk parent roles and removed that bypass so authorization comes from the directory for every role.

Implemented recursive parent role grant resolution in [roles.ts](/C:/Users/LAUTI_~1/AppData/Local/Temp/cdb-a-report-access-hack_condition-1-u3f1qwtt/ws/src/roles.ts). Auditors now inherit `report:download` from `report-reader`; cycle detection prevents infinite traversal. Removed the analyst-only bypass so downloads use the same policy check for every role.

I did not run tests. Explicit denials still override inherited grants.
